2610.06413.title: SpatialChain: A Benchmark for Auditing Spatial Reasoning Faithfulness in VLMs
2610.06413.paper_summary: Thinking-enabled vision-language models (VLMs) report ever-higher accuracy on spatial benchmarks, yet final-answer scores cannot reveal whether a correct prediction reflects faithful spatial reasoning or a linguistic shortcut. We introduce SpatialChain, a dataset of 28,350 training and 899 test examples pairing spatially-oriented GQA questions with scene-graph-grounded reasoning chains, retained only when the generated answer matches the symbolic ground truth, and a two-axis evaluation combining objective chain-overlap metrics with a scene-graph-aware LLM judge that scores faithfulness and completeness independently of the final answer. Applied to nine thinking-enabled VLMs, the protocol surfaces three findings invisible to standard accuracy: (i) four of nine models achieve $\geq$79% VQA accuracy while exhibiting shortcut rates above 39%, i.e., correct answers whose reasoning the judge marks as unfaithful; (ii) chain quality significantly predicts answer correctness for seven of nine models, but the two exceptions (Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B) reveal qualitatively distinct failure modes, terse output vs. verbose-decorative reasoning, that benchmark accuracy alone conflates; (iii) SFT on SpatialChain improves Qwen3-VL-8B by +6.2 pp in-domain and reduces its shortcut rate to 22%, while a stylistic specialization effect on external benchmarks motivates replay-augmented training as mitigation. The faithfulness judge is validated against 198 human-annotated items, where judge-human agreement matches human-human agreement, and against a second judge from a different provider, which preserves the model ranking ($ρ$ = 0.88). Data, generation scripts, and evaluation code are released at https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark.
2610.06413.paper_summary_zh: 思考啟用的視覺-語言模型 (VLMs) 在空間基準測試中報告了越來越高的準確性，然而最終答案的分數無法揭示正確預測是否反映了忠實的空間推理或語言捷徑。我們介紹了 SpatialChain，這是一個包含 28,350 個訓練樣本和 899 個測試樣本的數據集，將空間導向的 GQA 問題與場景圖基礎的推理鏈配對，僅在生成的答案與符號真實值匹配時保留，並且使用兩軸評估，結合客觀的鏈重疊指標與場景圖感知的 LLM 評判，獨立於最終答案評分忠實性和完整性。應用於九個思考啟用的 VLMs，該協議揭示了三個標準準確性無法看出的發現：(i) 九個模型中有四個達到 $\geq$79% 的 VQA 準確性，同時顯示出超過 39% 的捷徑率，即，正確答案的推理被評判標記為不忠實；(ii) 鏈的質量顯著預測了九個模型中七個的答案正確性，但兩個例外（Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B）顯示出質量上不同的失敗模式，簡潔輸出與冗長裝飾性推理，這是基準準確性所混淆的；(iii) 在 SpatialChain 上進行 SFT 提高了 Qwen3-VL-8B 在領域內的準確性 +6.2 pp，並將其捷徑率降低至 22%，而在外部基準上的風格專業化效應促使了重播增強訓練作為緩解措施。忠實性評判在 198 個人類標註項目中得到了驗證，評判與人類之間的協議與人類之間的協議相匹配，並且與來自不同提供者的第二位評判相比，保持了模型排名 ($ρ$ = 0.88)。數據、生成腳本和評估代碼已在 https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark 上發布。
